title: 電気磁気学Ⅱ
subtitle: Electromagnetics II
educationalGoal:
The learning goal is to acquire the basic knowledge of electricity regarding the interaction between electric current and magnetic field, and to be able to apply it to specific problems through physical and mathematical considerations. Students will utilize AI and:
(1) learn the basics of electric and magnetic fields and their interactions
(2) learn magnetic field strength and electromagnetic force
advice:
This is a basic course of electromagnetics.
If necessary, learning may take place using digital methods such as online (distance) or on-demand classes. We will cover the following materials:
Chapter 6. Current and magnetic field
Chapter 7. Electromagnetic Induction
Chapter 8. Inductance

We will review the chapter 1-5 lessons learned in “Electromagnetism I” according to students' achievement
in order to better understand Chapters 6-8.
Students will use AI for self-study and report writing.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain Bio Savart's Law and Ampere's Law.
Be able to describe the electromagnetic force acting on the conductor.
Be able to analyze the effects of magnetic fields on currents using Faraday's law for electromagnetic induction.
Be able to explain the self and mutual inductance.
